title: 第600章 风藏第599章 断风
content_zh:
不知过了多久，许星遥的意识才从无尽的黑暗中缓缓浮起。
第一个感觉是冷，寒意仿佛渗入了骨髓深处。
第二个感觉是痛，浑身上下无处不痛，尤其是胸口那道几乎将他整个人劈开的伤口，每一次呼吸都伴随着撕心裂肺的剧痛。
他艰难地睁开眼睛，视野一片模糊，只能看到灰白色的光芒在晃动。
“我没死……”
许星遥喃喃自语，声音沙哑得几乎听不见。
他挣扎着想要坐起身，却发现四肢百骸都像散了架一般，连抬手的力气都没有。
这里正是裂风峡的谷底，四周的罡风虽然依旧存在，但比之前在峡谷中时要弱得多，像是隔了一层厚重的屏障。
许星遥躺在一处较为平整的冰岩地面上，周围散落着破碎的冰屑和石块。
让他庆幸的是，那道几乎要了他命的巨型风刃并没有直接将他腰斩，而是在击碎了银鳞盾后，又被护体灵光削弱了一部分，最终只在他胸前留下了一道深可见骨的伤口，却没有伤及内脏要害。
“运气还算不错。”
许星遥深吸一口气，开始尝试调动体内残存的灵力。
然而，当他试图运转《太始寒天章》时，却发现自己体内的经脉受损严重，灵力的流通极为不畅。
更要命的是，那股侵入体内的“裂风罡煞”
依旧盘踞在经脉和丹田中，不断侵蚀着他的灵力根基，阻碍着伤势的恢复。
“必须先驱逐罡煞之气！”
许星遥咬牙，从储物袋中取出一瓶丹药。
这是药玉炼制的“驱煞丹”
，专门用来对付各种阴邪煞气。
他一口气吞服了三枚，然后全力运转功法，引导药力去冲击那些盘踞在经脉中的罡煞之气。

这个过程极为痛苦。
罡煞之气如同无数根细针，扎在他的经脉内壁上，每驱散一丝，都伴随着剧烈的刺痛。
许星遥额头青筋暴起，汗水涔涔而下，一遍又一遍地运转功法，配合药力，如同刮骨疗毒般，一点点将那些罡煞之气逼出体外。
时间一分一秒过去，足足花了一整日的功夫，许星遥才将体内大半的罡煞之气驱逐出去。
剩下的那些太过深入经脉和丹田，需要慢慢调理，短期内难以根除。
不过，即便如此，他的状态也已经好转了许多。
他又服下几枚疗伤和复元的丹药，调息一番，感觉灵力恢复了一些，这才缓缓站起身来，在谷底探索起来。
行了约莫一盏茶的功夫，前方的景象忽然一变。
只见左侧的崖壁上，出现了一座坍塌了大半的石门。
石门高约三丈，宽约两丈，通体由一种墨黑色的石材雕琢而成，表面刻满了密密麻麻的符文图案。
然而，岁月的侵蚀让这座石门显得破败不堪，顶部塌陷了一大块，露出后面幽深的甬道。
门楣上的浮雕已经被风化得面目全非，只能依稀辨认出一些古老的纹路。
“莫非这就是古修遗迹？”
许星遥心中一喜，快步走上前去。
他站在石门前，仔细端详了一番。
这些符文虽然古老，但并不算太过复杂，似乎是某种封印阵法。
不过，由于石门破损严重，封印的力量已经消散殆尽，只剩下一层薄薄的灵光附着在表面。
他伸出手，轻轻按在石门上。
“嗡——”
石门发出一声沉闷的震颤，随后缓缓向内打开。

一股陈腐的气息扑面而来，许星遥屏住呼吸，迈步走了进去。
甬道很窄，仅容一人通过。
content_en:
I don't know how long it took before Xu Xingyao's consciousness slowly emerged from the endless darkness.
The first feeling was cold, the chill seemed to penetrate deep into the bone marrow.
The second feeling was pain. There was pain everywhere in his body, especially the wound on his chest that almost split his whole body. Every breath was accompanied by heartbreaking pain.
He opened his eyes with difficulty, his vision was blurred, and he could only see gray-white light shaking.
"I'm not dead..."
Xu Xingyao murmured to himself, his voice so hoarse that it was almost inaudible.
He struggled to sit up, but found that all his limbs seemed to be falling apart, and he didn't even have the strength to raise his hands.
This is the bottom of the Split Wind Gorge. Although the surrounding strong winds still exist, they are much weaker than when they were in the canyon before, as if separated by a thick barrier.
Xu Xingyao was lying on a relatively flat ice rock ground, with broken ice chips and stones scattered around.
Fortunately for him, the giant wind blade that almost killed him did not directly cut him in half. Instead, after shattering the silver scale shield, it was partially weakened by the protective spiritual light. In the end, it only left a bone-deep wound on his chest, but it did not damage the vital organs.
"Not bad luck."
Xu Xingyao took a deep breath and began to try to mobilize the remaining spiritual power in his body.
However, when he tried to operate the "Taishi Hantian Chapter", he found that the meridians in his body were seriously damaged and the circulation of spiritual power was extremely difficult.
What's even more terrible is that the "Splitting Wind Gangsha" that invades the body
It was still entrenched in his meridians and Dantian, constantly eroding his spiritual power foundation and hindering the recovery of his injuries.
"We must drive away the evil spirit first!"
Xu Xingyao gritted his teeth and took out a bottle of pills from his storage bag.
This is the "evil expelling pill" made from medicinal jade
, specially used to deal with all kinds of evil spirits.
He swallowed three pills in one breath, and then used all his strength to run his technique, directing the power of the medicine to attack the evil spirits entrenched in his meridians.
This process is extremely painful.
The evil spirit was like countless fine needles pricking the inner walls of his meridians. Every time it was dispersed, it was accompanied by severe stinging pain.
The veins on Xu Xingyao's forehead popped out, and sweat trickled down. He ran the exercises over and over again, combined with the power of the medicine, like scraping bones to cure poison, and forced the evil energy out of the body bit by bit.
Time passed by, and it took a full day's work before Xu Xingyao expelled most of the evil energy from his body.
The remaining ones are too deep into the meridians and Dantian and need to be adjusted slowly, and are difficult to eradicate in the short term.
However, even so, his condition has improved a lot.
He took a few more healing and recovery elixirs, adjusted his breath, and felt that his spiritual power had recovered a little. Then he slowly stood up and started exploring at the bottom of the valley.
After walking for about a cup of tea, the scene ahead suddenly changed.
I saw a mostly collapsed stone gate on the cliff on the left.
The stone gate is about three feet high and two feet wide. The entire body is carved from a dark black stone, and its surface is covered with dense rune patterns.
However, the erosion of the years has made this stone gate look dilapidated, and a large piece of the top has collapsed, revealing the deep corridor behind it.
The relief on the lintel has been weathered beyond recognition, and only some ancient patterns can be vaguely discerned.
"Could this be the ruins of ancient cultivation?"
Xu Xingyao felt happy and walked forward quickly.
He stood in front of the stone door and looked at it carefully.
Although these runes are ancient, they are not too complicated and seem to be some kind of sealing formation.
However, due to the serious damage to the stone door, the power of the seal has dissipated, leaving only a thin layer of spiritual light attached to the surface.
He stretched out his hand and pressed it gently on the stone door.
"Buzz——"
The stone door made a dull tremor, and then slowly opened inwards.
A stale breath hit his face, Xu Xingyao held his breath and stepped in.
The corridor is very narrow, onlyAllow one person to pass.
